newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT book profit on sale to Tenneco.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT book profit on sale to Tenneco.

text.p: Dutch paper group KNP BT said on Monday the sale of its worldwide plastic packaging operations to Tenneco Packaging of the U.S. would result in a book profit of some 180 million guilders.
The deal involves seventeen companies in some ten countries, with a total turnover of one billion guilders (us$550 million) and 3,000 employees.
KNP BT said it expected the deal to be finalised at the end of April.
"The sale of the plastic packaging activities means KNP BT will concentrate on the production of corrugated board paper and solid board," the company said.
KNP BT had said on January 16 it was in exclusive talks for the sale of its plastic packaging activities to Tenneco Packaging, a fully owned subsidiary of Tenneco Inc.
